title: Cosmic Oracle Sphere
description: A glowing teal reptilian creature stands at the center of a large transparent spherical device. The sphere contains radiating colorful energy tendrils, floating orbs, a small green lizard-like being on the right, and concentric glowing rings in pink and blue.
prompt: A teal reptilian alien with large eyes stands inside a massive transparent spherical machine, viewed from behind. Bright neon energy beams in yellow, green, pink and blue radiate outward from its head like a halo. Inside the sphere float small glowing orbs, a tiny green lizard creature on the right, and concentric glowing target rings in pink and blue. The entire scene is set against a dark cosmic background with subtle grid lines, highly detailed, vibrant neon colors, surreal sci-fi atmosphere.
